job: Create a deterministic HOMES truth registry that separates verified on-chain facts, source-reported venue rules, explicit unknowns, and not-established legal or fund claims without turning any token fact into an ownership, return, or house-funding promise.
reject: a verified on-chain fact lacks a dated block receipt or disagrees with the checked-in mint artifact
a venue rule is presented as an Aura-controlled contract fact rather than a dated third-party source report
a source identifier is duplicated, unresolved, malformed, or not attached to every asserted fact
an unknown or not-established fact carries a value that could be mistaken for evidence
trust, treasury, staking, fee claims, property fund, properties, distributions, ownership, equity, yield, return, or house-funding status is inferred from token existence
the live X Layer mainnet token is conflated with the separate X Layer testnet settlement lab
a mutable or aliased registry can drift after validation
the registry performs a runtime network, provider, wallet, payment, transfer, claim, or persistence action
a website 3D, rendering, animation, engine, scene, public visual, model, texture, shader, camera, lighting, motion, or quality-tier path changes
verification: fixture: every asserted fact resolves only to its declared source identifiers
fixture: verified facts require a chain receipt with block and timestamp while source-reported facts remain attributed to the venue or network publisher
fixture: explicit unknown and not-established claims carry no asserted value
fixture: required legal, fund, treasury, staking, claim, property, and distribution boundaries cannot be omitted or promoted
fixture: the canonical registry is detached, deeply frozen, deterministic, and has no runtime side effect

evidence.dependencyGate: G02 independently verified; Graph v2 gate 14/14 and authority pass at HM01 start
evidence.writeOwnership: No active manifest owns an overlapping path; IP02 and UX03 are blocked and every other instantiated node is verified.
evidence.existingSurfaceAudit: token.ts is the canonical live token identity module, the mint artifact is a dated on-chain read, fund.ts mixes live zero-state with future design rules, and no typed registry currently distinguishes verified, source-reported, unknown, and not-established truth classes.
evidence.sourceReview: On 2026-08-25 the official X Layer network documentation still identified mainnet chain 196 and rpc.xlayer.tech; XLaunch documentation still described the 1% pool fee, 60/40 quote-side split, locked-liquidity mechanics, and stock-wrapper risks. Token-specific identity and supply remain pinned to the checked-in on-chain mint receipt rather than scraped market copy.
